summary: At digest 2c189ad0a6c54769e0f5c3904757a4a14a46add1a1e021e9327a9ff3ab733511, the earlier state, focus, loading, retry, copy and mobile gaps are closed: D-01–D-03 and B01–B09 cover the relevant empty, interrupted, partial-failure and recovery states; the 390×851 previews have no horizontal overflow and the approval controls render 46px tall. One important integration gap remains after publication of modern-auth ref bc7fc72: its return-destination sanitizer currently discards the CLI approval route and code fragment, while the frozen implementation tasks name only AppRoutes/LoginPage and leave the now-concrete shared-auth seams unresolved.

findings.description: A signed-out user following verification_uri_complete cannot currently carry the one-time CLI code through the newly published shared login flow. The modern-auth sanitizer rejects /cli/authorize and strips fragments, while ProtectedRoute drops the hash before the approval component can read and clear it. Manual B02 entry remains a fallback, but the approved B01 seamless return path is broken and the frozen task paths do not identify the additional integration seams now required.
evidence: specs/023-agent-cli/contracts/device-auth.md:11 requires verification_uri_complete to carry #user_code and requires shared login to preserve a validated local pathname/search/hash.

specs/023-agent-cli/design.md:77-78 defines B01 safe local approval return and B02 manual entry only when the fragment is missing; lines 87-91 require deterministic focus, fragment clearing and 390px recovery behavior.

specs/023-agent-cli/plan.md:46 and specs/023-agent-cli/tasks.md:41-43 scope the frontend work to AppRoutes, LoginPage and the new CLI component, without naming the published authFlow, ProtectedRoute, AuthEntry or provider-completion return seams.
origin/feat/modern-auth@bc7fc72:frontend/src/features/auth/authFlow.ts:10-18 allowlists existing destinations only, rejects /cli/authorize and returns no hash.
origin/feat/modern-auth@bc7fc72:frontend/src/components/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx:15-28 constructs the login destination from pathname plus search and omits location.hash.

origin/feat/modern-auth@bc7fc72:frontend/src/features/auth/AuthEntry.tsx:31-42 and frontend/src/features/auth/ProviderCompletionPage.tsx:41-43 route email/password/provider completion through safeAuthDestination, so the loss affects every configured shared-login method.
findings.recommendation: Amend the frozen plan and T014-T015 to name the published shared-auth return seams and test the complete signed-out journey. The implementation must validate and clear #user_code before redirect, retain the normalized code locally through password, email-code, Google and Apple round trips, return only to allowlisted /cli/authorize, and restore B02 or B04 focus. Add focused tests for the direct fragment link, every configured login method, hostile external/protocol-relative destinations, missing or stale retained state, and the 390×851 viewport.
